technical.summary: Bullish momentum signals (MACD crossover, volume spike, OBV) conflict with longer-term bearish structure (below 50/200 MAs, below Ichimoku cloud), creating a moderate-probability swing entry with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: DHI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 60 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 60-day earnings window adds moderate event risk to already hostile volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD bullish crossover + 15x volume spike + OBV confirmation create genuine short-term momentum signal in extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy zone) with support at 74.51 nearby.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA with bearish Ichimoku cloud structure, VIX crisis regime (367.2) creates hostile volatility backdrop, zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk within 60 days, and stochRSI overbought signals momentum exhaustion—technical setup conflicts with macro environment.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — moderate entry risk; support at 74.51 provides downside cushion but resistance at 81.44 caps upside in bearish structure

decision.entry_rationale: MACD bullish crossover with 15x volume spike and OBV confirmation create genuine short-term momentum in extreme fear sentiment. However, bearish macro environment and technical structure conflicts outweigh swing opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (367.2) combined with price trapped below 50/200 EMAs and Ichimoku cloud creates hostile volatility backdrop; 60-day earnings window adds event risk to already unstable setup.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents show bullish momentum signals but macro/fundamental/risk agents strongly oppose entry; debate winner is bear with high confidence
